payload.claim: No test in tests/test_witness_gate.py ever lets `run_tests` raise once a mutant has actually applied, so the `except Exception as exc:` branch that converts an unexpected exception from `run_tests` into a controlled `error` GateResult is never exercised (the two tests that raise inside `run_tests` do so only for mutants that never applied, so `run_tests` is never called). Replacing the whole inner `try/except Exception` with a bare `tests_result = run_tests([criterion.witness])` call would leave all nine tests passing while an exception from a real `tests`-gate invocation would now propagate uncaught instead of being reported as `error`.
